title: Rheologic testing of wet kaolin reveals frictional and bi-viscous behavior typical of crustal materials
transcription: Table 1 manually transcribed and cross-checked against the publisher HTML and PDF text. Original downloadable supplement was not obtained; this CSV is our transcription.
evidence_type: Four published fitted coefficient sets from real creep-recovery measurements; not raw time-series observations.
water_content: Study tested 62 and 66% water by mass. Table 1 does not identify the water content of its creep-recovery coefficient sets. No assignment is made here.
temperature: Not specified for Table 1 in the accessed article.
strain_convention: Engineering shear strain, equation (1); no factor of two in its creep formula.
history_limitation: The original stepped experiment used a different fit for each load. Here each row is used in a separate idealized rest-to-load-to-release calculation. No interpolation across stresses or validation of arbitrary histories is claimed.
